source.name: Oklahoma Department of Wildlife Conservation — "Crunch the Numbers and Up Your Drawing Odds" (Outdoor Oklahoma Journal), 2025-26 controlled hunt draw data tables

notes: ODWC controlled hunts drawing held June 2025 (2025-26 hunts; pronghorn = 2025 season). Per-hunt rows come from the data tables embedded in the ODWC article https://www.wildlifedepartment.com/outdoorok/ooj/increase-your-winning-odds-controlled-hunts (tables "Deer Hunts", "Youth Deer Hunts", "Deer Hunts (Nonambulatory, Vehicle)", "Elk Hunts", "Pronghorn Hunts": Hunt #, Location & Permit, Hunt Type, Begin/End Date, Applicants, Permits, Draw Ratio). Row sums equal ODWC's published category totals exactly (deer 69,199 applicants / 3,708 permits; youth deer 4,173 / 812; motor-vehicle/non-ambulatory deer 342 / 114; elk 37,906 / 306; pronghorn 13,501 / 40). huntCode = ODWC hunt number. tags = "Permits"; applicants = "Applicants", which ODWC says INCLUDES 1st through 3rd (elk, youth, non-ambulatory), 1st-2nd (pronghorn) or 1st-5th (deer) choice selections, so it is NOT first-choice applicants and is not split by residency. Residents and nonresidents draw from ONE pool (ODWC publishes no residency split), so draw.resident and draw.nonresident are null and the combined counts sit in tags/applicants. successPct is left null: ODWC publishes only a "Draw Ratio" (applicants ÷ permits, e.g. 1 in 216.7) built on all-choice applicants. Points: ODWC uses weighted-random preference points (each point = one extra chance, not highest-points-first); for elk and pronghorn half the permits are first drawn among applicants with 20+ points. No points-needed or per-point-level data is published, so no minPoints/pointLines. unit = the hunt area (WMA / NWR / Corps of Engineers area / county), lightly normalized so draw and harvest spell it the same (e.g. "Wichita Mts. NWR" and "Wichita Mountains WR" -> "Wichita Mountains NWR"; "Ft." -> "Fort"; "COE" -> "CoE"). The full ODWC location string is kept in label. weapon: ODWC "Gun" -> rifle (any legal firearm), Muzzleloader -> muzzleloader, Archery -> archery; youth "Shotgun"/"Muzzleloader/Shotgun" hunts have no weapon set. Season dates are from the same tables. Elk and pronghorn controlled hunts are once in a lifetime. Not included: turkey categories (out of scope); landowner antelope permit drawing (no statistics published); 2026 drawing (June 2026) statistics were not yet published by ODWC as of 2026-10-07. Over-the-counter seasons (statewide deer; elk on private land in open zones with zone quotas; archery pronghorn) have no draw and are not rows here.
